milestones.text: First video: flat explainer cards, captions and a narrator.
Channel starts: story episodes with Nora, Walt, Sam and Leo in night-time scenes.
Nightly production: one new public video per channel every night.
Channel starts: wordless short films with Pip, the Glim and a day counter.
Characters get feelings (moods, tears, sweat), felt-piano jingles on every channel.
Search-first titles: each episode opens by promising what you will learn.
New look: paper collage, sticker characters, newsprint clippings.
New look: editorial desk, documents, coin towers, framed story scenes.
Films grow to five minutes; Pip is redrawn (hair, duffel coat, orange scarf).
Pip gets a new voice; first film with the redrawn Pip (Rain or Shine).
Physics checks: storyboards and rendered frames are checked so nothing floats or passes through anything.
Story captions on torn newsprint for every shot, and a moral card at the end of each film.
